Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.

Ticket:
URGENT: Portal credit card payments failing

Hello, I have patients sitting in the waiting room right now trying to pay their balances through the online portal, and every single credit card transaction is throwing an error on the payment screen. I've tried refreshing the page and clearing the browser cache, but it keeps declining valid cards. Please look into this immediately as our front desk is backed up trying to process these payments manually.
